features: Product catalog with multi-category filtering (Clothes, Shoes, Makeup, Accessories)
Reseller / Wholesale mode toggle with margin calculator & share to WhatsApp link
Live Flash Sale countdown timer with urgent badge
Interactive sliding Cart and Checkout drawer with COD & UPI options
Curated Lookbooks & Trending Collections with Instagram-style shop the look
Product Quick-View modal with size selector, color swatch, and instant wishlist
User review system with photo uploads and verified buyer badges
universal_guidelines: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes
Never use complete transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays
Ensure high contrast text for accessibility (WCAG AA compliant)
Generous spacing with Tailwind scale and clean bento layouts
